user.description:
After adding the device, press its button. It pairs through any of your proxies within range.

A second-hand device must be factory reset first: hold its button for 10 seconds.

Paste this into the proxy's ESPHome configuration and install it. The proxy appears here when it first connects.

```yaml
{snippet}```

The key is shown here only until you leave this dialog; it is kept in Home Assistant and can be shown again from the proxy's menu.

pairing_stalled.description:
{name} keeps repeating its pairing request although Home Assistant answered it. It was probably paired with another server, or Home Assistant was restored from an older backup.

Hold the device's button for 10 seconds to factory-reset it, then press it again. If that does not help, move the device closer to a proxy.
pairing_stalled.title: Pairing {name} stalled
